limits: Exact source snippets/anchors and all successful/negative fixture instances must be frozen at implementation. These are changes to actual new runtime code, not source grep or compile-only credit. M10 substitutes two existing same-typed fields and needs no invented original-creditor field. M13 deliberately weakens the combined exact-effect/supply predicate: supply omission alone is redundant under full-cell equality plus accepted kernel accounting, so no independent detection is claimed for that omission.
